desc: With the HK VP9A1, the best pistols (and the best shooters) get even better. The VP9’s well-deserved reputation for being a handgun that actually helps people shoot better is backed by numerous reports from law enforcement of qualifying scores improving signiﬁcantly now features the new enhanced VP9A1 L. Whether you are competing at formal matches or just against yourself at the range, the VP9L could be just the edge you’ve been looking for. The VP9A1 L now brings a total of four different sizes into the VP9A1 lineup, VP9K (compact), VP9X (crossover), VP9F (full-size), and the VP9L (long slide) rounds out a family of strikerﬁred weapons for any user.
